basicDetails.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities. Launched in 2013 under the auspices of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, this visionary scheme aims to extend crucial financial assistance to persons with disabilities (PwDs) across the state. It operates as a lifeline for individuals grappling with various disabilities, ensuring their financial security and enabling them to lead dignified lives. By providing a pension to eligible beneficiaries, MVSYS not only addresses the economic challenges faced by PwDs but also emphasizes inclusivity and equal opportunities. Through its implementation, the scheme not just disperses funds but fosters a culture of empathy and support, reaffirming the government&#39;s commitment to uplifting marginalized communities. In essence, MVSYS embodies the principles of social justice and empowerment, serving as a beacon of hope and resilience for individuals with disabilities in Rajasthan.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Beneficiary must be permanent resident of Rajasthan State.
1. The beneficiary must have any one of the following disabilities:

  - 40% or more disability (blindness, shortsightedness, locomotor disability, leprosy free, hearing loss, mental retardation, mental illness, dwarfism, eunuch)
  - Dwarfism with height less than 3 feet 6 inches.
  - Suffering from Eunuchism.
  - Cured leprosy or Silicosis disease.

1. Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000/-

basicDetails.schemeName: मुख्यमंत्री विशेष योग्यजन सम्मान पेंशन योजना

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: मुख्यमंत्री विशेष योग्यजन सम्मान पेंशन योजना (एम. वी. एस. वाई. एस.) अपने नागरिकों, विशेष रूप से विकलांग लोगों के कल्याण के प्रति राजस्थान सरकार की प्रतिबद्धता का प्रमाण है। सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग के तत्वावधान में 2013 में शुरू की गई इस दूरदर्शी योजना का उद्देश्य राज्य भर में विकलांग व्यक्तियों (पीडब्ल्यूडी) को महत्वपूर्ण वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। यह विभिन्न अक्षमताओं से जूझ रहे व्यक्तियों के लिए एक जीवन रेखा के रूप में काम करता है, उनकी वित्तीय सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करता है और उन्हें सम्मानजनक जीवन जीने में सक्षम बनाता है। पात्र लाभार्थियों को पेंशन प्रदान करके, एम. वी. एस. वाई. एस. न केवल दिव्यांगजनों के सामने आने वाली आर्थिक चुनौतियों का समाधान करता है, बल्कि समावेशिता और समान अवसरों पर भी जोर देता है। अपने कार्यान्वयन के माध्यम से, यह योजना न केवल धन का वितरण करती है, बल्कि सहानुभूति और समर्थन की संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देती है, जो हाशिए पर पड़े समुदायों के उत्थान के लिए सरकार की प्रतिबद्धता की पुष्टि करती है। संक्षेप में, एम. वी. एस. वाई. एस. सामाजिक न्याय और सशक्तिकरण के सिद्धांतों का प्रतीक है, जो राजस्थान में विकलांग व्यक्तियों के लिए आशा और लचीलेपन के प्रकाश स्तंभ के रूप में कार्य करता है।

faqs.question: What is this scheme about?

children.text: The "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana" (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities

faqs.answer_md: The "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana" (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities

faqs.question: Is there any Disability Percentage ?

children.text: Applicant should be Disabled and Disability Percentage should be more than 40%.

faqs.answer_md: Applicant should be Disabled and Disability Percentage should be more than 40%.

faqs.question: Will the benefit of this scheme be provided to all the citizens of the state?

children.text: No, the benefit of this scheme will be provided only to unmarried daughters of the labor family of Rajasthan state.

faqs.answer_md: No, the benefit of this scheme will be provided only to unmarried daughters of the labor family of Rajasthan state.

faqs.question: Is there a income Criteria in this scheme?

children.text: The Annual Income of Beneficiary Family should not be more than ₹60,000/-.

faqs.answer_md: The Annual Income of Beneficiary Family should not be more than [?]60,000/-.

faqs.question: Is there an application fee?

children.text: Fees for Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme is ₹33/- . Payment of fees can be done through E-Mitra.

faqs.answer_md: Fees for Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme is [?]33/- . Payment of fees can be done through E-Mitra.

faqs.question: What is DBT?

children.text: DBT stands for Direct Benefit Transfer. It is a mechanism used by governments to transfer financial assistance or subsidies directly to the bank accounts of beneficiaries.

faqs.answer_md: DBT stands for Direct Benefit Transfer. It is a mechanism used by governments to transfer financial assistance or subsidies directly to the bank accounts of beneficiaries.

faqs.question: What is Bhamashah Card ?

children.text: The Bhamashah card provided by this yojana is linked to a bank account in the name of the housewife. The card also provides women with biometric identification and core banking functions, as well as a variety of cash benefits that are directly transferred to their bank account.

faqs.answer_md: The Bhamashah card provided by this yojana is linked to a bank account in the name of the housewife. The card also provides women with biometric identification and core banking functions, as well as a variety of cash benefits that are directly transferred to their bank account.

faqs.question: Can applicants from outside Rajasthan apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer_md: No.

faqs.question: What is IFSC code?

children.text: The IFSC code uniquely identifies a specific bank branch participating in electronic fund transfer systems in India.

faqs.answer_md: The IFSC code uniquely identifies a specific bank branch participating in electronic fund transfer systems in India.

faqs.question: Is there a Payment Frequency?

children.text: Pension will be provided on monthly basis.

children.text: डी. बी. टी. का अर्थ है प्रत्यक्ष लाभ हस्तांतरण। यह सरकारों द्वारा वित्तीय सहायता या सब्सिडी को सीधे लाभार्थियों के बैंक खातों में हस्तांतरित करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली एक प्रणाली है।
